{"metadata":{"description":"Local-first long-term memory and temporal knowledge graph plugin for DeepSeek Harness","id":"gh:1338528351","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-memory-graph","slug":"zmh2000829/dsh-memory-graph","topics":["agent-memory","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","knowledge-graph","sqlite","typescript"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Local-first long-term memory and temporal knowledge graph plugin for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-memory-graph"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Local-first long-term memory and a temporal knowledge graph for DeepSeek Harness.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"简体中文 · Installation · Configuration · Security"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"`dsh-memory-graph` gives a DSH agent durable, auditable memory without changing DeepSeek Harness its"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"elf. It is installed as a regular Cordis plugin, stores data in a private local SQLite database, rec"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"alls relevant facts before the first model step, and renders the resulting entity graph inside DSH W"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"s relevant facts before the first model step, and renders the resulting entity graph inside DSH Web."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Why dsh-memory-graph"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Non-invasive by design.** No Harness source patch and no agent-loop fork. Unloading the plugin r"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"emoves its tools, listeners, route, and UI contributions.
- **Memory with history.** Stable facts ar"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"e superseded instead of overwritten, retain provenance, and can be reverted to the previous version."},{"id":"p7s4","text":"
- **A maintainable graph.** Canonical names, non-destructive alias conflict reporting, duplicate su"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"ggestions, entity merge/rename/delete, orphan discovery, reference-aware garbage collection, and nor"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"malized predicates keep the graph usable after months of conversations.
- **Chinese retrieval that w"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"orks.** FTS5 trigram indexing plus a short-query fallback handles continuous CJK text without relyin"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"g on whitespace tokenization.
- **Hybrid relevance.** Recall combines lexical match, graph proximity"},{"id":"p7s9","text":", importance, time decay, and explicit access reinforcement. Automatic recall is read-only and does "},{"id":"p7s10","text":"not artificially keep old memories alive.
- **Optional semantic recall.** An OpenAI-compatible embed"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"ding endpoint can add cosine similarity to the local hybrid ranker. It is off by default and falls b"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"ack to lexical/graph recall when no key or endpoint is available.
- **Bounded hot paths.** Write-sid"},{"id":"p7s13","text":"e embedding runs in a deduplicating background queue. Query-side embedding uses a short timeout, TTL"},{"id":"p7s14","text":" cache, and failure cooldown instead of exposing the 20-second indexing timeout to tools or first-st"},{"id":"p7s15","text":"ep injection.
- **A real per-turn control.** DSH Web exposes `Default`, `On this turn`, and `Off thi"},{"id":"p7s16","text":"s turn` beside the composer. The choice is latched for the next turn only and then resets.
- **Recov"},{"id":"p7s17","text":"erable source archives.** Completed turns can retain bounded local source text, optionally including"},{"id":"p7s18","text":" bounded tool results. Failed extraction can be retried without replaying the conversation.
- **Dura"},{"id":"p7s19","text":"ble failure handling.** Retryable SQLite writes enter a private file outbox and replay at startup; m"},{"id":"p7s20","text":"alformed or permanent failures move to a dead-letter directory.
- **Inspectable, not opaque.** Every"},{"id":"p7s21","text":" automatic memory can retain session, turn, event sequence, model route, extraction request, and ext"},{"id":"p7s22","text":"raction response.

Model-visible recalled context is written to th"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"e session log, so a recorded session remains reconstructable."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness with a configured profile such as `web`

- Git and npm"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Confirm that the CLI and profile are available:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The project is currently distributed directly from GitHub. Clone it, validate it, then link the loca"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"l checkout into a DSH profile:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Open the DSH Web interface and expand **Memory** in the sidebar. The default patch enables automatic"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" recall, automatic turn summarization, and visualization."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The dashboard leads with what DSH remembers and how it can affect later answers. Before a response, "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"relevant durable preferences, facts, constraints, decisions, and lessons can be recalled into contex"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"t. After a successful turn, reusable information can be extracted without treating every message as "},{"id":"p19s4","text":"memory. This usually works quietly and only for a relevant future question."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The **Knowledge graph** is a collapsed advanced view over the **profile-wide database shared by all "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"conversations**, not a diagram of the open conversation. Nodes are extracted entities, edges are rel"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"ationships, and `×N` means N memories support the same relationship. It is useful for inspecting ass"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"ociations, duplicate entities, and incorrect relationships; the memory list is the primary view for "},{"id":"p20s5","text":"understanding what may influence an answer. Use a separate profile or database `path` when isolation"},{"id":"p20s6","text":" what may influence an answer. Use a separate profile or database `path` when isolation is required."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"New summaries default to `summaryLanguage: auto`, which follows the dominant user language and emits"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" Simplified Chinese for Chinese conversations while preserving established proper names. Existing En"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"glish records are not silently translated or rewritten during upgrade."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Before submitting a prompt, the native-style **Memory · On**, **Memory · Off**, or **Memory · Mixed*"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"* control shows the effective profile defaults directly. Its menu can use that profile default or ov"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"erride the next turn only. **On once** forces recall, archive, and summarization even when their glo"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"bal defaults are off; **Off once** suppresses those automatic actions. The override resets after the"},{"id":"p22s5","text":" turn, and manual `memory_*` tools remain available. Delete buttons permanently remove a selected me"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"mory and its provenance-owned relations after confirmation."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Verify the installed link at any time:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Data and security"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- The default database is `$DSH_HOME/memory-graph.sqlite` and is created with mode `0600`.
- The sto"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"re rejects an incompatible schema and databases owned by another application.
- Dashboard reads retu"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"rn `Cache-Control: no-store`; writes require POST, JSON, a process-random token, and validated Host,"},{"id":"p26s4","text":" Origin, and Fetch Metadata.
- Recalled memory is explicitly framed as reference data rather than in"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"structions.
- Automatic summarization sends the selected conversation excerpt to the configured mode"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"l route. Disable `autoSummarize` or use a local route when that data must not leave the host.
- `arc"},{"id":"p26s7","text":"hiveTurns` stores a bounded turn tail locally and applies both age and per-session count retention. "},{"id":"p26s8","text":"`memory_archive_expand.truncated` says explicitly whether the archive is complete. `captureToolResul"},{"id":"p26s9","text":"ts` is off by default because tool output may contain sensitive data.
- Semantic recall sends memory"},{"id":"p26s10","text":"/query text to `semanticEndpoint` only when explicitly enabled. Use a local endpoint when those text"},{"id":"p26s11","text":"s must not leave the host."}],"truncated":true}
